spec_expectation: Administration > Roles and Permissions

actual_staging: Role Name | Description | Template | Role Type | Users | Action
notes: Description is 2nd; 'Role Type' not 'Type'; 'Users' not 'Users Assigned'; 'Action' singular.

spec_expectation: System badge on system roles
actual_staging: 'System'/'Custom' chip in Role Type column

spec_expectation: Create Custom Role
actual_staging: Create Custom Role

spec_expectation: Edit / Delete / View Permissions
actual_staging: Custom roles: kebab (three-dot) menu contains 'View Permissions' + 'Delete'. System roles: kebab has 'View Permissions' only (no Delete). Locked roles (Office, Time Clock): view-only (eye icon). Edit is an inline pencil icon on editable roles.
notes: Corrected 2026-07-01 per user screenshot — earlier probe had only inspected a System role's kebab and wrongly concluded Delete was absent. Delete IS available for Custom roles, matching spec (SV-7502).

spec_expectation: Open read-only
actual_staging: Show lock icon; only View Permissions; no edit

spec_expectation: Read-only summary dialog with scannable ON/OFF
actual_staging: Full-page read-only view (not a dialog) listing areas + CRUD labels + toggle state; disabled parents collapse children

spec_expectation: Template selection → Role details → Permission editor → Save
actual_staging: Step 1 'Choose a template' dialog (Skip / Apply); Step 2 'Create Role' single page: Basic Details (Role Name*, Description) + Permissions; footer Cancel / Create
notes: 'Create' is the save button label (not 'Save').

spec_expectation: Enabling Edit auto-enables View; Delete auto-enables Edit+View
actual_staging: Confirmed on Work Orders: Create & Edit auto-checked View; Delete kept all three on

spec_expectation: Disabling View disables Edit+Delete
actual_staging: Confirmed: turning View OFF cleared Create & Edit and Delete

spec_expectation: Trigger on enabling Part Sales/Invoicing CRUD while See Financial Data OFF; text '[Area] requires "See Financial Data" to be enabled. Enable it?'; Confirm/Cancel
actual_staging: Triggered by 'Create & Edit' (NOT View). Title: 'Enable See Financial Data?' Body: 'Invoicing & Payments requires See Financial Data. Enable it to grant this permission?' Buttons: Cancel / Enable. Cancel reverts the checkbox.

spec_expectation: Spec ambiguous (6 vs 7; possible Integrations)
actual_staging: Exactly 6: App Settings, Service, Parts, Finance, Data Import, View/Manage Wages. NO 'Integrations' sub-setting exists in the role editor.
notes: Integrations (QuickBooks, IBS) exists only as a top-level Administration area, not a role permission.

spec_expectation: OFF hides 3 children; ON reveals; settings preserved
actual_staging: Confirmed: OFF hides Part sales / Catalog and Inventory / Vendor and order management; ON reveals them

spec_expectation: Tech vs Full; UX only, not access control
actual_staging: Segmented control with options 'Full View' and 'Tech view'; info text 'View mode — Controls interface complexity, not access controls.'

spec_expectation: See Financial Data; Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable; View History Logs
actual_staging: 'See Financial Data', 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', 'View History Logs'

spec_expectation: Template selection → Role details → Permission editor → Save
actual_staging: Button labelled exactly 'Create Custom Role' opens a template picker titled 'Choose a template' (subtext 'Start from a template to pre-fill settings, or skip to start from scratch') listing 11 system templates with 'Skip' and 'Apply' buttons. After Skip/Apply → 'Create Role' form with two sections: 'Basic Details' (Role Name [required], Description) and 'Permissions'.
verdict: VERIFIED (staging, live admin session, 2026-07-01) — MATCH (exact labels confirmed)
notes: Confirms/extends VIU-04 and VIU-08 with the exact picker title, subtext, 11-template count, and Skip/Apply button labels.

spec_expectation: Areas: Work Orders, WO Lines, Schedule, Customers, Invoicing, Timesheets, Page Access, cross-cutting toggles
actual_staging: Exact headings: 'Work orders' (View / Create & Edit / Delete; 'View mode' segmented control Full View / Tech view; toggles 'Review work orders', 'Pick parts', 'Order parts'); 'Work order lines' (Create & Edit / Delete — NO View); 'Schedule' (View / Create & Edit / Delete); 'Customers' (View / Create & Edit / Delete); 'Invoicing & payments' (View / Create & Edit / 'Delete / Reverse'); 'Timesheets' (View / Create & Edit — NO Delete); 'Page Access' toggles: 'Parts Department', 'Reports', 'Customer portal', 'Settings', 'Billing Portal'; 'Cross-Cutting Toggles': 'See Financial Data', 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', 'View History Logs'. Permission search box present; footer buttons 'Cancel' / 'Create'.
verdict: VERIFIED (staging, live admin session, 2026-07-01) — MATCH (exact section labels captured)
notes: The edit tier is labelled 'Create & Edit' (not 'Edit'); WO Lines has no independent View; Timesheets has no Delete; there is a permission search box.

spec_expectation: Invoicing & Payments: View / Edit / Delete
actual_staging: The Invoicing & payments third (delete-tier) control is labelled exactly 'Delete / Reverse', not just 'Delete'. Other CRUD sections use plain 'Delete'.
verdict: VERIFIED (staging, live admin session, 2026-07-01) — DISCREPANCY (label 'Delete / Reverse')
notes: Test cases that reference 'Invoicing Delete' should read the control as 'Delete / Reverse' in the editor.

topic: View mode control (Full View / Tech view)
spec_expectation: Tech vs Full; UX only, not access control
actual_staging: Segmented 'View mode' control under Work orders with options 'Full View' and 'Tech view'.
notes: Confirms VIU-14 (option labels 'Full View' / 'Tech view').

topic: CRUD tier cascade is SILENT (no popup)
spec_expectation: CRUD cascade both directions
actual_staging: Intra-section CRUD tiers cascade silently with no confirmation popup: enabling 'Create & Edit' auto-enables 'View'; enabling 'Delete' auto-enables View + Create & Edit; turning 'View' OFF force-disables Create & Edit + Delete (View is master). Confirmed on Customers: Delete with all off auto-enables View + Create & Edit + Delete silently.
notes: Confirms VIU-09/VIU-10; adds that the cascade is silent (no modal) and that View acts as master for its section.

topic: Invoicing → See Financial Data confirmation popup (exact text)
spec_expectation: Trigger on enabling Invoicing CRUD while See Financial Data OFF
actual_staging: Enabling Invoicing 'Create & Edit' or 'Delete / Reverse' while 'See Financial Data' is OFF shows a confirmation popup — title 'Enable See Financial Data?', body 'Invoicing & Payments requires See Financial Data. Enable it to grant this permission?', buttons [Cancel] [Enable]. Enable auto-enables Invoicing View+Create&Edit AND See Financial Data. Cancel changes nothing (permission blocked until dependency accepted).
verdict: VERIFIED (staging, live admin session, 2026-07-01) — MATCH (exact popup text captured)
notes: Confirms VIU-11 with exact title/body/button text. Cross-Cutting toggles (See Financial Data / View and Manage AP/AR Data / View History Logs) toggle independently — no popup, no mutual auto-enable.

spec_expectation: Row actions: Edit / Delete / View Permissions
actual_staging: Custom role with 0 users (deletable): kebab has 'View Permissions' and 'Delete' (Delete shown in red). Custom role WITH users (not deletable): kebab has only 'View Permissions' (Delete hidden). System roles: kebab has only 'View Permissions'. Locked system roles (Time Clock, Office): NO kebab at all — view-only eye icon + lock icon.
notes: Confirms/supersedes VIU-05: Delete IS available for deletable Custom roles, but is hidden for Custom roles that have users assigned. Also confirms VIU-06 (locked roles have no kebab).

topic: Doubled '/api' prefix on SSO auth-check (session hydration bug)
spec_expectation: Valid cookie session should hydrate the SPA without bouncing an authenticated user to /login
actual_staging: Staging auto-auth-check requests '/api/api/sso/check' (doubled '/api' prefix, because the axios baseURL already includes /api) → 404, so a valid cookie session does NOT hydrate the SPA and authenticated users are bounced to /login. Correct path should be '/api/sso/check'.
verdict: DISCREPANCY (functional bug; severity high — blocks session hydration on staging)
notes: Functional build bug, not a spec-wording issue. UI observation only; no secrets/session data recorded.

topic: No unsaved-changes confirmation on Create Role dialog X-close
spec_expectation: Unsaved edits should be protected by a discard/unsaved-changes confirmation
actual_staging: Closing the Create Role dialog via the X with unsaved permission toggles shows NO unsaved-changes / discard confirmation — the changes are silently dropped.
notes: Contrast with the Cancel/X footer; no guard against accidental data loss.

topic: Dependency-UX inconsistency (silent cascade vs confirmation popup)
spec_expectation: Consistent UX for permission 'requires' dependencies
actual_staging: Two different UX treatments for the same underlying 'requires' pattern: intra-section CRUD dependencies auto-cascade SILENTLY (see VIU-20), but the Invoicing → See Financial Data dependency uses an explicit confirmation popup (see VIU-21).
notes: Same 'requires' relationship, two divergent UX patterns.

topic: Per-role CRUD gating on the restricted Tech user (live login)
spec_expectation: A role granting WO View only should let the user read Work Orders but not create/edit/delete; adding Create & Edit should expose New/edit; adding Delete should expose per-row delete.
actual_staging: Logged in AS the restricted 'Tech' user (tech@shopview.com) after assigning each config as admin and re-logging-in as Tech. WO View only: Tech sees ONLY the Work Orders nav; WO list is read-only with NO 'New' button and other modules hidden. WO View + Create & Edit: the 'New' button appears (create/edit enabled), no delete. WO View + Create & Edit + Delete: full WO management including per-row delete. All three behaved PER SPEC.
verdict: VERIFIED (staging, live per-role Tech session, 2026-07-01) — MATCH
notes: Confirms the runtime effect of the CRUD tiers on a real restricted user, complementing the editor-side cascade findings (VIU-09/10/20).

topic: Per-role page-access nav gating (Reports / Customers / combination) on Tech
spec_expectation: Page-access toggles and area View permissions should gate the exact nav set the user sees.
actual_staging: As Tech: Customers View only → ONLY Customers nav, read-only list, other modules hidden. Page Access Reports ON → Reports nav + report suite visible; OFF → Reports nav hidden (gate is exact). Combination WO View + Customers View + Reports ON → nav = EXACTLY Work Orders, Customers, Reports and nothing else. All behaved PER SPEC.
verdict: VERIFIED (staging, live per-role Tech session, 2026-07-01) — MATCH
notes: Nav is the exact union of granted areas + enabled page-access toggles; no leakage of ungranted modules.

spec_expectation: Page Access Settings ON should expose the Settings/admin routes (Settings, Staff, Roles & Permissions, Locations, Departments).
actual_staging: As Tech with Page Access Settings ON: the settings routes are visible under the Administration area — they are CHILDREN of '/administration' (Settings, Staff, Roles & Permissions, Locations, Departments). Navigating to '/settings' returns a 404 'coffee break' page; the working path is '/administration'.
verdict: VERIFIED (staging, live per-role Tech session, 2026-07-01) — DISCREPANCY (path drift: spec/docs may say /settings; actual is /administration, and /settings 404s)
notes: D1: correct any admin/role-config navigation that says '/settings' to '/administration'. In this suite the test-case JSON already navigates to '/administration/roles-permissions', so no literal '/settings' URL required correcting.

topic: View-mode / parts / financial effects carried in wrapper; verified inside WO detail
spec_expectation: WO View Mode (Tech/Full), WO sub-toggles (Pick parts / Order parts), and See Financial Data should take effect for the assigned user.
actual_staging: As Tech: the permission wrapper carries view_mode (tech / woTechViewMode), woPickParts/woOrderParts, and seeFinancialData (true/false) correctly. The visible effects manifest INSIDE the WO detail page (and invoicing for financial), NOT on the WO list: the WO list looks the same in Tech vs Full view; Pick/Order parts actions live inside the WO detail; financial figures/prices are not on the WO list and appear in WO detail / invoicing. All behaved PER SPEC.
verdict: VERIFIED (staging, live per-role Tech session, 2026-07-01) — MATCH (with verification-location note)
notes: D3: verification steps for view-mode, delete, pick/order-parts, and see-financial-data must inspect the WO detail (invoicing for financial), not the WO list.

spec_expectation: A no-access baseline role could be created with zero permissions to represent a true no-access user.
actual_staging: Attempting to create a role with zero permissions is rejected — the API enforces 'At least one permission is required.' A true no-access role is therefore not configurable; the minimal case is a single-permission role (e.g. timesheetsView → Tech lands on own Timesheets with an empty top nav).
verdict: VERIFIED (staging, live per-role Tech session, 2026-07-01) — DISCREPANCY (design limit: min 1 permission enforced)
notes: D2: document as a known constraint; any 'empty role' baseline should use a single-permission minimal role instead. No such empty-role baseline login case exists in this suite, so none required conversion.

topic: Permission propagation requires re-login + brief settle
spec_expectation: After reassigning a role to a user, the new permissions should apply to that user.
actual_staging: After reassigning a role to the Tech user, the new permissions take effect only after the user logs out and logs back in (fresh login) AND a brief settle. Without a fresh login the prior permission set persists. Behaved as observed on every per-role reassignment.
verdict: VERIFIED (staging, live per-role Tech session, 2026-07-01) — behavior note
notes: D4: added as a precondition/note to per-role (assign-and-login-as-user) cases: 'After assigning the role, log out and log back in as the user (fresh login) so the new permissions load.'

topic: Invoicing Delete AP/AR dependency gate missing
spec_expectation: Enabling Invoicing 'Delete / Reverse' should enforce BOTH gates: See Financial Data AND View and Manage AP/AR Data (the AP/AR gate should fire when AP/AR is OFF).
actual_staging: In the Admin role editor with See Financial Data ON and View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF, enabling Invoicing 'Delete / Reverse' checked View + Create&Edit + Delete but did NOT trigger any 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' gate/modal and left AP/AR unchecked. The financial gate works; the AP/AR gate is absent.
notes: ref SP-INV-005 (test-run FAIL). Financial dependency gate fires correctly; the AP/AR dependency gate for Invoicing Delete never fires.

topic: Time Clock system role grants workOrdersView (WO/DI reachable)
spec_expectation: The 'Time Clock' system role is clock-in/out-only and should NOT grant Work Orders access; Work Orders and Digital Inspections should be unreachable for it.
actual_staging: The live 'Time Clock' system role grants workOrdersView, so a Time-Clock user lands on /workorders with the WO list rendered and can reach Digital Inspections on a work-order line read-only (role lacks Work Order Lines rights). This contradicts the clock-in/out-only intent (description says 'Clock in/out only'). Effective fe-permissions verified live via Tech quick-login (match=true).
notes: ref DI-111 / DI-117 (test-run FAILs). No dedicated Digital Inspections/checklist permission exists in this org; DI access is governed by the existing WO permissions.

topic: CRUD dependency cascade is UI-editor-only, not server-enforced
spec_expectation: The CRUD dependency cascade (Delete requires Edit requires View) should be enforced by the backend, not just the UI editor.
actual_staging: The CRUD dependency cascade is UI-editor-only and is NOT server-enforced: a direct API PUT of a Delete/Edit permission WITHOUT its View parent is accepted by the backend (no validation error), producing a stored role state the UI editor would never allow.
notes: ref batch C. The dependency invariant is only maintained client-side; the API trusts the caller.

spec_expectation: The inspection-templates route should be guarded by settingsService and denied to roles without it.
actual_staging: The /administration/inspection-templates route lacks a settingsService guard — it is reachable read-only via direct URL by any role holding any OTHER settings sub-permission. The Settings > Service MENU path is correctly denied, but the direct route is not protected by the same guard.
notes: ref batch E. Menu-level gating is correct; route-level guard on inspection-templates is missing.

topic: Granted surfaces return 404 in this build (grant reaches 404)
spec_expectation: A granted permission should lead to the working feature/page, not a 404.
actual_staging: Several granted surfaces return 404 in this build even when the permission IS granted (Customer/Billing Portal, some Invoicing/AP-AR pages) — the grant path reaches a 404 rather than the feature. These cases were recorded BLOCKED (non-destructive-unverifiable) because the feature could not be exercised.
notes: ref batch B blocked set. Cannot distinguish permission bug from build-gap 404; flagged for build/deploy check.

spec_expectation: Setting the WO view_mode (Full View / Tech view) should carry the view-mode choice on the role.
actual_staging: Setting view_mode full/tech auto-adds a woFullViewMode / woTechViewMode marker permission to the stored role (the choice is materialized as an explicit permission entry rather than a scalar field only).
notes: Informational, not a defect. Confirms how view_mode is persisted; complements VIU-14/VIU-19/VIU-29.
